ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon Userinit Child Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uncommon "userinit.exe" child processes, which could be a sign of uncommon shells or login scripts used for persistence.

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\userinit\\\.exe$") AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\WINDOWS\\\\explorer\\\.exe$")) AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*netlogon\\\.bat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*UsrLogon\\\.cmd.*")) OR process_command_line = "PowerShell\.exe" OR (process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\proquota\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\proquota\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Citrix\\\\HDX\\\\bin\\\\cmstart\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Citrix\\\\HDX\\\\bin\\\\icast\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Citrix\\\\System32\\\\icast\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Citrix\\\\HDX\\\\bin\\\\cmstart\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Citrix\\\\HDX\\\\bin\\\\icast\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Citrix\\\\System32\\\\icast\\\.exe$")) OR process_path = "None")
